title: Shared affine trend, conditional screening
description: A = t + 1 and B = t share one assumed latent value. Exact cancellation excludes A even though the marginal intervals overlap.

title: Missing consistency point, screening withheld
description: The box diagnostic would exclude A, but a missing consistency point forces the operational pool to retain the entire universe.

title: Learned relation, screening withheld
description: A learned correlation cannot justify the common-world premise. Every candidate is retained; deliberately conflicting reported values expose the model mismatch.
